coaching.headline: Every Fangtooth, both Primes and nine structures to two. A clean fucking demolition, with Murdock and Grux carving up the damage dealers the only stain.
coaching.team: The team took every Fangtooth, the Mini Prime, the Orb Prime, the Genesis Core and all three Seedlings, and broke nine structures while losing two. The enemy led on kills early, the team drew level at seven apiece and never trailed again, finishing twenty-seven to seventeen. Each of the four won fights was followed shortly by a structure or an objective. The only allied structures lost were two outer towers, shortly after Grux killed Lt. Belica and Sparrow.

focus.title: Find Grux before the damage steps up
focus.action: When Grux has not shown on the map, Lt. Belica and Sparrow stay within reach of Steel or Adele before stepping forward. Every Grux kill landed on Sparrow, Lt. Belica or Bayle, and a pull or a drag into a stun is a shit way to die.

16.9.call: Steel killed Greystone, Sparrow killed Dekker, Grux killed Sparrow, Gideon killed Adele, and Lt. Belica killed Grux, Murdock and Gideon. The fight went 5-2 and two enemy outer towers fell shortly after. That is the template: win the fight, then hit the structures.

18.4.call: Grux killed Lt. Belica and Sparrow with no enemy deaths. The team took an enemy inner tower soon after, and two allied outer towers fell in the same stretch, the only structures the enemy took all game. That stretch went two structures to one against the team.

24.2.call: Lt. Belica killed Greystone and Grux and Steel killed Gideon, with no allied deaths. The fight went 3-0, Lt. Belica killed Dekker shortly after, an enemy inhibitor fell and the Orb Prime went to the team soon after that.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324 pulled a proper support shift: the most wards placed in the game, the most assists in the game, a hand in more than a third of the team's kills and the second-most damage mitigated on the team.

Adele was the first hero to die in three fights, twice to Murdock. Opening snack is not peel, so when Murdock or Gideon is in range, Adele has Iron Rose's damage reduction running before Imperial Lash dashes in.
00196e12-6345-4794-a4cf-38569b3aad4f: RoboDracula did the jungle job: the second-most objective damage in the game, the most healing on the team, ward placements well above the recorded Bayle norm, and every Fangtooth and both Primes went to the team.

Hero damage sat well under the recorded Bayle norm, a big angry swordsman tickling people. In fights, Bayle lands Skull Crusher on Murdock or Grux first, so the armor shred is up before Sparrow starts shooting.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Sparrow led the whole game in objective damage, cleared the most enemy wards on the team and killed Grux three times. Big objective numbers and real vision work from the carry seat. Keep that shit.

Six deaths, the most on the team and above the recorded Sparrow norm, with hero damage well under norm. Murdock got three, first blood included, so when Murdock activates Hot Pursuit, Sparrow vanishes with Heightened Senses instead of dueling.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim was a fucking menace on Lt. Belica: the most kills and gold in the game, the second-most hero damage, three kills in the largest fight of the game, and Gideon never killed Lt. Belica.
Ten kills with three deaths is the bar next game. Void Drone drains nearby mana and Neural Disruptor hits harder on missing mana, so Lt. Belica drops the drone near Gideon before firing the ultimate.
b0da1dff-7b73-4b93-8c71-7b29a4619ed1: negreoleo was the best player in this lobby: the most hero damage in the game, by far the most damage mitigated, one death, and Greystone dead to Steel four times without a kill in return. An absolute wrecking ball.

One death while eating the most damage of any ally is the standard now. Murdock got that lone kill, so when Murdock starts shooting at Steel or the backline, Force Shield goes up between Murdock and the target first.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.matchup: Adele and Sparrow faced carry Murdock and support Dekker. Dekker stuns with Stasis Bomb, longer at range, slows with Photon Disruptor, blocks heroes with Containment Fence and slows or stuns with Ion Strike. Dekker built Marshal, Tainted Charm and Unbroken Will, so healing near Dekker was cut. Murdock, the enemy's top hero damage dealer, killed Adele twice, and Gideon killed Adele twice. The allied duo died three times before the ten-minute mark and the enemy duo once.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.build: Dawnstar adds physical armor, and basic attacks on heroes stack a reduction to that hero's damage dealt, faster on melee hits; rooting a hero with Imperial Lash or Queen's Garden adds attack speed and a stack. Tainted Charm cuts healing and slows near enemy heroes, with Grux, the biggest healer in the game, the main target. Hexbound Bracers adds health, heal and shield power, mana from damage taken and less damage from hero basic attacks, which suits facing Murdock. Adele's listed ability scaling uses physical power, health and armor, so Gaussian Greaves pays through armor, health, haste and the double-jump slow rather than magical power.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.eternal: Krix adds maximum health and size. Voracity restores a little health and gold on unit kills, which sits awkwardly beside Sanctification's diminishing minion gold, while Cannibalism permanently adds health on takedowns and suits the most assists in the game. Regenerative Tissue is the first-minor alternative, regenerating health after a stretch without hero damage, trading kill sustain for recovery between fights. Festering Wounds is not needed here: four of the five allied players already carried an anti-heal item, Adele's Tainted Charm included.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.augment: Court of Roses makes Iron Rose also grant the nearest ally a barrier with damage reduction, with Thorned Vines attaching to nearby enemy heroes at reduced damage. Sparrow and Lt. Belica were the allies Grux and Murdock killed most, so the barrier had obvious users. Seeds of Dominion is the alternative, spawning a slowing Thornbush under the Imperial Lash target and shortening the Lash cooldown, trading ally protection for more catch. Barrier uptime is not recorded.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.crest: Sanctification's Safeguard shields Adele and nearby heroes and adds tenacity while the shield holds, shortening Dekker's Stasis Bomb stun and Murdock's Static Trap root during that window. The crest also raises the ward cap and pays passive gold while minion gold diminishes, and Adele placed the most wards in the game. Activations are not recorded.
16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3.improvement: The winning core is Dawnstar, Xenia and Raiment of Renewal; Adele had Dawnstar only. Xenia shields an ally standing close and adds both armors, at the cost of Gaussian Greaves' double-jump slow. Adele finished with no magical armor item while Gideon, a magical damage dealer, killed Adele twice, so Xenia is the comparison for the Greaves slot. Raiment of Renewal adds health, tenacity and out-of-combat regeneration, at the cost of Hexbound Bracers' mana and basic-attack reduction. A won game proves neither swap.

00196e12-6345-4794-a4cf-38569b3aad4f.matchup: Bayle's jungle opponent was Grux, who pulls and stuns with Smash 'n Grab, drags heroes with Stampede, stuns nearby heroes with Warlord's Challenge and heals per hero hit with Double Pain. Grux built Sky Splitter, Tainted Rounds, Basilisk and Rapture: Tainted Rounds cuts healing on basic attacks, which hits Dire Howl's heal and Solstice, and Basilisk shreds physical armor. Bayle and Grux killed each other once apiece, and Grux had the most healing in the game. Murdock also killed Bayle once.
00196e12-6345-4794-a4cf-38569b3aad4f.build: Malady explodes killed units and adds stacking bonus damage on low-health heroes, with takedowns resetting the cooldown. Tainted Trident cuts healing on physical damage, with Grux and Greystone both healing, and adds damage to Bayle's abilities on blighted targets. Alternator boosts Skull Crusher, Bayle's alternate ability, and can evolve after enough hero hits with Skull Crusher. Solstice adds both armors and charges a basic attack that hits harder and heals, with takedowns filling the charge. The package brings sustain and armor; hero damage still sat well under the recorded Bayle norm.
00196e12-6345-4794-a4cf-38569b3aad4f.eternal: Lotus randomly grants small damage, haste, speed or health bonuses on a timer and on takedowns. Masterpiece adds stacking bonus damage and movement speed on kills, and Immaculate cuts damage taken while near full health. Immaculate and Berserk pay at opposite ends of the health bar, and Bayle took the second-most damage of any ally. Prima Donna is the second-minor alternative, adding damage to heroes while taking more damage from everything, which targets the low hero damage at a survival cost.
00196e12-6345-4794-a4cf-38569b3aad4f.augment: Swift Strikes grants attack speed for one attack after each ability cast and starts the basic attack chain on the heavy third hit, at reduced damage. That pairs with weaving Skull Crusher, Cursed Edge and Dire Howl between attacks. Frenzied Fighter is the alternative, keeping Berserk's attack speed, movement speed and tenacity active for as long as Bayle stays under the health threshold, trading the weave for a low-health brawl.
00196e12-6345-4794-a4cf-38569b3aad4f.crest: Brutallax's Purifying Rage cleanses all debuffs and grants heavy tenacity, extended by successful basic attacks. That answers Gideon's tether root, Dekker's Stasis Bomb and the stuns from Grux, and the extension rewards staying on one target. Activations are not recorded.
00196e12-6345-4794-a4cf-38569b3aad4f.improvement: The winning core is Manta Scythe, Ashbringer and Onixian Quiver; Bayle built none of the three. Manta Scythe adds attack speed, lifesteal, more damage to minions and small monsters and bonus damage on targets with no nearby ally, aimed at the hero-damage gap, at the cost of Tainted Trident's anti-heal. Three other allies already carried an anti-heal item, so Tainted Trident is the slot to compare. With the second-most objective damage in the game and deaths under the recorded Bayle norm, the jungle job got done either way.

a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.matchup: Sparrow and Adele faced carry Murdock and support Dekker. Murdock was the enemy's top hero damage dealer: Buckshot shreds physical armor and pushes back, Static Trap roots, Hot Pursuit adds movement and attack speed and resets on takedowns, and Long Arm of the Law ignores physical armor at unlimited range. Murdock killed Sparrow three times, first blood included, and Sparrow killed Murdock twice. Dekker's Stasis Bomb stuns and Containment Fence blocks heroes. Across the match Grux also killed Sparrow three times.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.build: Lightning Hawk builds momentum while moving or attacking and slows with the empowered hit. Tainted Rounds cuts healing on basic attacks, with Grux the biggest healer in the game, and adds on-hit damage that grows as the target's health drops. Vanquisher adds physical penetration and executes heroes at very low health, and Terminus turns lifesteal overhealing into a shield. Every completed item adds critical chance, and Inner Fire's arrows can critically strike. None of the four adds armor, against physical damage from Murdock and Grux.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles when Sparrow damages a low-health hero, with more missiles from bonus attack speed. Forage adds gold and experience per minion or monster kill. Wind-Rider grants attack speed after a dash, leap or teleport or on leaving stealth, so reappearing from Heightened Senses triggers the bonus. With the most deaths on the team, Natural Resistance is the first-minor alternative, cleansing crowd control and adding tenacity at low health against Static Trap, Stasis Bomb and Grux's stuns, trading Forage's income.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.augment: Endless Hunt resets Sparrow's basic ability cooldowns on takedowns and permanently adds physical penetration per takedown, and Sparrow had seven kills and three assists to feed the stacks. Sun Shards is the alternative, making basic attacks ricochet with on-hit effects at reduced effectiveness, trading the resets for damage spread across grouped targets. Cooldown resets are not recorded.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.crest: Liberator's Purifying Guard cleanses all debuffs and adds a short shield, a direct answer to Murdock's Static Trap root and Dekker's slows when pressed in time. Liberator also adds attack speed and lifesteal, and that lifesteal feeds Terminus's overheal shield. Activations are not recorded.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c.improvement: The winning core is Storm Breaker, Sky Splitter and Spectra; Sparrow built none of the three. Storm Breaker is the direct comparison for Lightning Hawk: the same momentum trigger, releasing chaining lightning that applies on-hit effects instead of a slow. Sky Splitter's current-health damage and Spectra's on-hit damage pair with Relentless's basic-attack stacks, where the current build leans on critical strikes. With hero damage well under the recorded Sparrow norm, that on-hit core is the comparison; a won game does not prove the current build is the problem.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.matchup: Lt. Belica's mid opponent was Gideon, who slows with Void Breach, drops a meteor with Cosmic Rift, leaps with Torn Space for extra maximum mana and pulls with Black Hole. Gideon's passive turns the basic attack after an ability hit into a tether that roots after a delay. Gideon built Azure Core, Soulbinder and Tainted Scepter; Azure Core and Soulbinder both add mana, so Void Drone's drain and Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage had a target. Lt. Belica killed Gideon three times and Gideon never killed Lt. Belica. Across the match Grux killed Lt. Belica twice and Murdock once.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Combustion adds bonus damage around the target on ability damage, recharging faster on hero damage. Noxia marks a hero on ability damage and pays maximum-health damage when a separate ability follows, so Seismic Assault into Void Bomb or Neural Disruptor is the natural sequence. Caustica ignores part of magical armor, Wraith Leggings adds magical penetration and bonus ability damage on low-health heroes, and Oblivion Crown multiplies magical power. Dekker's Unbroken Will was the only completed enemy item with magical armor, so Caustica's armor-scaling bonus had little to bite on.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Aion grants mana regeneration on spell casts and gold from spell damage to heroes, which pays with the second-most hero damage in the game. Bottomless Vial restores a potion charge and adds permanent magical power for each river buff Lt. Belica kills, though river buff credit is not recorded per player. Runic Focus adds magical power from current mana, which Combustion's mana supports. Sacrifice is the first-minor alternative, regenerating missing mana on ability hits and hero kills, which suits the most kills in the game, trading the river-buff power.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.augment: Combat Veteran adds a little movement speed and passive experience that grows with level. Innovation strengthens each ability at max rank and adds ability haste, so faster levels feed the passive sooner. Pulsefire Rounds is the alternative, adding mixed on-hit damage to the SMG between casts, and Devastating Bombs makes Void Bomb hit isolated targets harder; both trade the experience for damage. Level timing is not recorded.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.crest: Soulbearer's Anima gives a shield, magical lifesteal and movement speed for a short window, which pays while spells are landing on heroes. Epoch is the draft alternative, entering stasis to wait out incoming damage from Grux or Murdock, the two heroes who killed Lt. Belica, trading the lifesteal and speed for time. Activations are not recorded.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.improvement: Lt. Belica built the full winning core of Combustion, Noxia and Wraith Leggings, plus Caustica and Oblivion Crown. Against an enemy team with one completed magical armor item, Caustica is the slot to compare: Magnify adds health and omnivamp for surviving Grux, and Timewarp shortens non-ultimate cooldowns on a clock, both trading Caustica's penetration. With the most kills and gold in the game, the build is a sound keep.

b0da1dff-7b73-4b93-8c71-7b29a4619ed1.matchup: Steel's offlane opponent was Greystone, who leaps with Assault The Gates, shreds physical armor with Make Way, slows with Sacred Oath, deflects basic attacks periodically with Stoicism and heals in stasis with Stone Forged Soul. Greystone built Basilisk, Tainted Blade and Mutilator, armor shred and anti-heal that both bite on a tank. Steel killed Greystone four times and Greystone finished without a kill. Across the match Murdock was the enemy's top hero damage dealer and got Steel's only death.
b0da1dff-7b73-4b93-8c71-7b29a4619ed1.build: Fire Blossom burns nearby enemies, ramping on one target. Fist Of Razuul builds stacks while dealing or taking damage and empowers a basic attack that heals for part of the bonus. Tainted Guard cuts the healing of any hero basic-attacking Steel and bleeds that hero, with Grux, the biggest healer in the game, and Murdock as basic attackers. Aegis Of Agawar raises both armors, more below a health threshold, and Raiment of Renewal adds health, tenacity and out-of-combat regeneration. The stack came with by far the most damage mitigated in the game.
b0da1dff-7b73-4b93-8c71-7b29a4619ed1.eternal: Nihil grants Doom while damaging heroes, adding power and both armors the longer Doom persists, with permanent growth on level-ups and takedowns. From the Abyss restores health in hero combat or out of enemy vision, and Adaptive Plating adds matching armor as Steel takes damage, which also feeds Heavy Metal's armor scaling. That suits a frontliner who took the most damage of any ally. Inescapable is the second-minor alternative: Greystone's Assault The Gates, Gideon's Torn Space and Grux's Stampede all leap or dash, trading Adaptive Plating's armor for a slow.
b0da1dff-7b73-4b93-8c71-7b29a4619ed1.augment: Heavy Metal adds magical on-hit damage to heavy punches and Shield Bash based on total physical and magical armor, and Fire Blossom, Tainted Guard and Aegis Of Agawar all raise armor, so the augment scaled with this inventory. Adaptive Force is the alternative when blocking Murdock's shots matters more: Force Shield gets two charges and a shorter cooldown at a smaller size. Bulldozer adds damage reduction to Bull Rush, trading on-hit damage for a safer engage.
b0da1dff-7b73-4b93-8c71-7b29a4619ed1.crest: Saphir's Mantle's Atlas briefly increases Steel's size and maximum health, damages nearby heroes and permanently adds maximum health from that damage. That rewards activating inside a fight rather than before one, and Steel had the most hero damage in the game. Activations are not recorded.
b0da1dff-7b73-4b93-8c71-7b29a4619ed1.improvement: The winning core is Fire Blossom, Tainted Guard and Flux Matrix; Steel skipped only Flux Matrix. Flux Matrix makes nearby enemy heroes take more magical damage and cuts enemy tenacity, and Lt. Belica plus Steel's own Shield Bash, Bull Rush and Shield Slam deal magical damage, so the amplification would have two users. The cost is Aegis Of Agawar's health and percentage armor boost, armor that also feeds Heavy Metal. With the most hero damage in the game and one death, the current build is a sound keep.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Bayle Kingslayer (knockback), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
ourKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
ourKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
ourKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Stasis Bomb stun → Photon Disruptor slow → Containment Fence wall → Ion Strike slow ult
enemyKits.winCondition: lock a target with stun + fence and let the team collapse
enemyKits.passive: Rocket Boots mobility, refreshed by abilities
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun/fence into a kill
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb; the fence zones — flank around it

enemyKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
enemyKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
enemyKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
enemyKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
enemyKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
enemyKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
enemyKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
enemyKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

enemyKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
enemyKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
enemyKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
enemyKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start
